text: The paper reports that its placebo decomposition improves classification over the Elicit select-then-generate baseline from 71% to 98% correct (p=0.0004). Inspecting ICE traces showed the gain came almost entirely from per-paragraph answering, not from trial-arm-based classification, which tended to conclude it was unclear whether there was a placebo.
title: Placebo classification improves from 71% to 98% via paragraph-wise decomposition
